paradigm: code_as_policy (ASPIRE-style: write program -> fly -> read per-step trace -> repair -> distil)

skills.failure_signature: hit by a projectile that was visible earlier but absent from obs['objects'] in the last ~5-20 steps before impact; balls leave the 90 deg FOV ~200 units before arriving because they come in obliquely
skills.when_to_apply: any projectile with constant velocity and a sensor limited to the field of view
skills.repair_strategy: keep a track per object id (position, velocity, tic seen) and extrapolate in closed form while unseen; drop it once its forward coordinate is past the body or it stops (velocity ~0 = exploded)
skills.code_sketch: tracks[id]=(x,y,vx,vy,tic) if speed>2; px=x+vx*(tic_now-tic); drop if df < -(B+4)
skills.validated: life 2 survived 638 vs 296; no further deaths from forgotten-but-seen balls

skills.failure_signature: policy is safe, then a 'return to centre' rule moves it into a ball's predicted path; left/right chattering around the interval edge
skills.when_to_apply: a reactive dodger that also has a default positioning behaviour
skills.repair_strategy: single target selection: candidates = 0, interval edges, room centre, walls; pick the min-cost candidate among those that are safe; centre preference only enters the cost
skills.code_sketch: best=min([c for c in cands if feasible(c)], key=lambda c: abs(c)+w*abs(c-mid))

skills.failure_signature: oscillating actions; overshoot after releasing the key
skills.when_to_apply: actuator with acceleration and friction (strafe: v_{k+1}=0.64 v_k+2.5 per 4-tic step, terminal ~6.9 u/tic, coast ~9 x v units)
skills.repair_strategy: steer on target minus predicted coast distance; switch target only with hysteresis (switch_gain)
skills.code_sketch: err=best-9.5*vl; LEFT if err>6, RIGHT if err<-6 else NOOP

skills.failure_signature: no feasible target found although a safe offset existed close to a wall
skills.when_to_apply: wall clearance parameter larger than body radius (16)
skills.repair_strategy: wall margin = body radius + a few units (20)
skills.validated: open-loop replay of life 2 death: v3 holds position instead of stepping into the ball; life 3 reached 811

skills.failure_signature: when nothing is provably safe, the fallback runs into the most imminent ball
skills.when_to_apply: dense fire, every candidate conflicts with some threat
skills.repair_strategy: score each candidate (plus a 25-point lateral grid) by the arrival time of the earliest threat it conflicts with and take the one that conflicts latest; re-plan next step

skills.failure_signature: death at a wall (y<110 or y>680): aimed balls converge on a pinned player, escape is one-sided
skills.when_to_apply: bounded strafe line with aimed projectiles
skills.repair_strategy: centre preference in target cost (w_center 0.5) plus a wall-proximity penalty of 2 per unit inside 140 units of a wall
skills.validated: partially: life 5 lasted 2095 but still died pinned at the -y wall (y~107)

skills.failure_signature: hit by an oblique ball (|v_lat/v_close| 0.4-0.75) that the single-point test at the player's plane predicted as a near miss
skills.when_to_apply: box-overlap collision with projectiles moving obliquely
skills.repair_strategy: a ball can hit while its forward coordinate is within B=22 (body 16 + ball 6) of the player's; block the lateral span swept over [t_in, t_out] widened by B + 7 margin; crossing rule uses t_in/t_out
skills.validated: life 4: 883, first hit at step 159 (later than any earlier life's first hit except life 2)

skills.failure_signature: reachability overestimated when moving the other way
skills.when_to_apply: time-to-reach estimates with nonzero current velocity
skills.repair_strategy: tau(d)=|d|/6.5+6 + 0.8|v| if reversing, -0.5|v| if already moving that way

skills.failure_signature: player gliding out of a ball's span presses the opposite key because coast would overshoot the edge target, stops inside the span and is hit
skills.when_to_apply: steering towards a target with momentum
skills.repair_strategy: if the closed-form coast path s(t)=9 vl (1-0.64^(t/4)) is clear of every blocked span during its window and ends within 45 of the target, release (noop) instead of braking
skills.code_sketch: if braking and abs(err)<45 and coast_safe(vl): return NOOP

skills.failure_signature: fatal ball never present in obs['objects'] at any step (fired from outside the FOV, steep vy ~ -7); 11 imps alive by tic 2000
skills.when_to_apply: late game, many monsters, player near a wall
skills.repair_strategy: not repaired in the official run (no life left). Candidates: stay farther from walls late in the episode; track monsters by id and treat out-of-view monsters' last positions as potential shooters
